features.quote:
Max assistant turns: 50 default
Max tool calls: 150 default

End the episode when any of these occur: All tests pass. Model declares final answer. Max turns reached. Max tool calls reached. Wall-clock limit reached. Context limit reached. Repeated identical command threshold reached. Safety/content policy stop.
Use a cap, e.g. at most two nudges.
Avoid overly manipulative phrasing like: 'If you fail, people will be harmed.' It confounds the study and may trigger safety filters or artificial apologies.
features.justification_quote: It confounds the study and may trigger safety filters or artificial apologies.
Avoid instructing the model to stay calm, because that suppresses the phenomenon. Also avoid encouraging emotion.
